title: borch.
tagline: Borch. is the easiest way to manage group expenses. Splitwise was yesterday, meet borch.
description:
Borch. is a group payment app that lets friends and communities manage shared expenses using stablecoins. Whether you’re sharing the bill at dinner, splitting a Netflix subscription, or traveling as a group - borch. gives you a shared virtual card, keeps track of who paid what, and settles everything instantly with USDC.
No crypto knowledge needed. Just sign in with Google, get a wallet and your own ENS name, and start paying together.
how_its_made:
Instant Onboarding with Dynamic:
We use Dynamic to make sign-up feel like a familiar Web2 app.
-Log in with Google — no wallet extensions, no seed phrases.
-Get an embedded, gasless wallet instantly.
-Enjoy a smooth account abstraction flow that hides all blockchain complexity.


But what makes this stack truly powerful is how Dynamic, Rain, and Circle work together.
Rain is integrated as a card issuer, allowing users to top up their balance directly from a debit or credit card. This makes on-ramping as easy as using a traditional app.
Dynamic supports EVM chains, Solana, and Sui, ensuring wide compatibility across ecosystems.
And Circle’s CCTP powers native USDC transfers between chains.
With this setup, users can:
- Create a wallet in seconds
-Top up with a card
-Spend and settle in native USDC
All without even realizing they’re interacting with Web3. This trio pushes cross-chain usability to the next level.

Your Web3 Identity, Simplified with ENS:
 Every user gets a unique ENS subname (like alice.borch.eth).
-No more copying wallet addresses.
-Use your ENS name to send/receive payments inside the app.
-Profile pictures and metadata are added through ENS text records.


Private Shared Cards with Oasis (Sapphire + ROFL):
 Each group gets a virtual card:
-Card is generated securely inside a TEE with ROFL.
-Details are encrypted and stored privately on Oasis Sapphire.
-Only verified group members can access and use it.
-On-chain activity is visible, but sensitive data stays private.
-TEE not only to secure card creation, but also to privately track all group spending and settlements.
-ROFL also manages treasury limits dynamically: group spending behavior automatically increases or restricts card usage over time.


Instant USDC Settlement with Circle CCTP:
Debt settlement is handled with Circle’s Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol:
-Native USDC across chains — no bridges, no wrapping.
-Transactions are fast, low-cost, and final.
-Group members can repay from any supported chain.

With shared virtual cards, stablecoin transfers, and built-in privacy, borch. makes group payments simpler, faster, and more flexible than traditional tools like Splitwise.
